children: Angelos M. Stergiou, President and CEO, sold 26,606 shares of SELLAS Life Sciences Group common stock on Nov. 18, 2026, at $19.178 per share for a total of $510,250. The sale funded tax withholding obligations related to the performance-based vesting of previously granted restricted stock units after the primary endpoint was met in the issuer’s Phase 3 REGAL study. Stergiou directly owned 1,734,896 shares after the transaction.
